pending.description: Always true: the clip's analysis is queued or running.

AnalysisStats.description: The uploader's stats from the killfeed.

multiKill.description: Most of the uploader's kills in one round: `2k`, `3k`, `4k` or `ace`.

weapons.description: The uploader's kills per weapon (CS2 names: `ak47`, `awp`, ...).

kills.description: Every kill in the killfeed, in order.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

autoTags.description: Tags found by killfeed analysis, e.g. `4k`, `hs`, `smoke-kill`.

canEdit.description: The viewer may edit and delete it (uploader or admin).

deletedAt.description: Set while it's in the trash (restorable for 7 days).

error.description: Why processing failed. Only shown to the uploader.

oneOf.description:
Why a clip failed processing, for the uploader's failed screen. Worked out from the
stored message (`clips.error`), whose permanent forms the worker writes with the
constants below.

failureReason.description: The kind of failure, for the uploader's failed screen.

heldUntil.description: Saved for the show until then; only shown to the uploader.

multiKill.description: The uploader's best round from killfeed analysis: `2k`, `3k`, `4k` or `ace`.

playbackUrl.description: Read SAS (2 h) once ready; only on the single-clip endpoints.

players.description: Friends tagged as playing in it.

shareUrl.description: Public link while sharing is on; only shown to those who can manage it.

tags.description: The uploader's tags (what editing the clip changes).

teaser.description:
Someone else's clip saved for the show: only its title, uploader, map and length,
with a blurred poster. No tags, killfeed or reactions, and no playback except for
people in the live show whose lineup has it (`GET /api/clips/{id}`, to preload it).

hold.description:
"Save it for the show": hidden from others until it plays in a show, you post it,
or a week passes. Ignored while shows aren't open to you.

myPov.description: Recorded from your own point of view.

uploadUrl.description:
Write SAS for the original: upload with Put Block + Put Block List, then call
`POST /api/clips/{id}/complete`. Valid for 15 minutes plus a minute per 100 MB
(at most 2 h).

CurrentShow.description: The show that's on, in brief: what every page's "Live · Join" pill needs.

url.description: Read SAS for the original that downloads with its file name (2 h).

tieBreak.description: The host's picks for tied categories.

ErrorBody.description: Error payload for every non-2xx `/api` response.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Never contains internals for 5xx responses.

oneOf.description:
Only on the 409 from ending a show with a tied vote: the tied clips of every tied
category, so the host breaks them all at once.

invitedBy.description: Handle of the admin who sent it; empty for invites seeded from `ADMIN_EMAILS`.

role.description: Role the user gets on first sign-in.

KillView.description: One killfeed row, followed from when it appeared.

t.description: Seconds from the start of the clip.

weapon.description: CS2's name, e.g. `ak47`; absent when it couldn't be read.

addedBy.description: Who put it in the lineup (the host for tonight's clips).

dropped.description: Left out by the host; stays for the next show.

shows.description: The show (lobby, hosting, the hold switch on upload) is open to you.

showsForEveryone.description: ...and to everyone, so uploads default to "Save it for the show".

Me.description: You, plus what's switched on for you.

Member.description: A user as other members see them (no email).

atMs.description: When in the clip, in milliseconds.

emoji.description: One of the six reactions, or 🍌 (marks a fail).

clipWinnerVotes.description: Votes the winners got, and how many people voted in each category.

clips.description: The clips it played, in order.

clipCount.description:
Clips they uploaded that you see: as many as `GET /api/clips?uploader={handle}`
lists for you. Others' clips saved for the show (decision 29) and unpublished
clips count only for their uploader.

featuredCount.description: Clips they play in (tagged by a friend), as many as `?player={handle}` lists.

PublicConfig.description:
Settings the SPA needs before it can log in. Served at runtime so one image works
for every environment.

mine.description: The viewer reacted with this emoji.

RevokeInvite.description: Emails travel in the body, never the URL, so they stay out of HTTP logs.

clipIds.description:
The clips still to play, in order. Ones left out are dropped (they stay for the
next show).

atMs.description: When in the clip, in milliseconds.

failContenders.description: Clips someone marked with 🍌: the fail of the night contenders.

lineup.description: In order: played clips first, then what's still to come; dropped ones last.

reactions.description: Every reaction tap, in clip order and time, for the replay.

voters.description: Who has voted so far, per category: the finale's "3 of 4 voted".

votes.description:
Votes per clip, once the show has ended. Empty until then, for everyone, so the
reveal isn't spoiled (decision 43).

TieBreak.description: The host's pick when a category's vote ties (decision 31).

Ties.description:
The tied clips of each category when `end` needs the host's pick; empty for a
category that isn't tied.

clips.description: With no show on: the clips the next one would play, in upload order.

oneOf.description: The last show that ended, for the lobby's "Last show" line.
The show that's on (lobby, live or finale), if any.

UpdateClip.description: Fields to change; omitted fields stay as they are.

map.description: `null` or an empty string clears it.

players.description:
Replaces the friends tagged as playing (user ids, up to 10). Friends tagged
already may stay after they've been disabled; new ones must be active members.

tags.description: Replaces the tags (up to 10; letters, digits and `-`).

UpdateProfile.description: Profile fields to change; omitted fields stay as they are.

handle.description: 2–32 characters: `a–z`, `0–9`, `-`, `_`, starting with a letter or digit.

steamName.description: Up to 64 characters; an empty string clears it.

Voters.description: Who has voted in each category (user ids), not for what.
